primary_problem: BTC volatility forecasting; financial volatility prioritized; other-domain mechanisms require transfer justification
outside_window_policy: flag for date verification or justified foundational exception; never automatic exclusion on year
inputs: Frozen received 7833 bibliographic groups and matching private abstracts; no new remote database query
reviewer_model: One editorial workflow assisted by deterministic rules; zero independent human adjudications asserted; no fabricated Cohen kappa

decision_semantics.retain_for_fulltext: Recover or adjudicate full text; not included study
decision_semantics.manual_review_pending: Ambiguous, contextual or origin mechanism; requires human decision
decision_semantics.exclude_title_abstract_provisional: Machine exclusion recommendation only; human validation pending

precedence: other financial volatility + forecast + deep signals
rule_source: scripts/screen_e2_literature.py::classify_record; features and matched terms are recorded per group
target_role_rule: Keyword conjunction does not prove volatility target, standalone comparator, causality, performance or methodological quality; these remain unverified

T1_attention_vision.expression: ("vision transformer" OR "self-attention") AND ("computer vision" OR image*) AND (transfer* OR adapt*)

T2_mixing_vision.expression: ("MLP-Mixer" OR "token mixing" OR "channel mixing") AND (vision OR image*) AND (transfer* OR adapt*)

T3_ssm_language.expression: ("selective state space" OR Mamba) AND (language OR speech OR audio) AND (transfer* OR adapt*)

transversal_local_semantics: Case-insensitive regex conjunction over received title and distinct private abstracts. Local lexical variants are in code; not equal to native WoS TS indexing or a new global search.
coverage_limits: WoS per-query totals/ranges and file-to-query assignment unconfirmed
Seven additional applied texts not fully extracted
selection_rule: Preserve historical Top10 score intervals; expose alternatives without treating mentions as comparator frequency or assigning unknown score=0. No final replacement/rank before source verification.
